source_locator: R2274: leaf 0031 (images 46-47), Divisionsbefehl Nr. 23, the move of 21 September 1939
current_activity: division moves into rest billets around Szymanów, Sucha and Bolimów to refit
notes: Event date: 1939-09-21. The same order (R2274, leaf 0031) moves the 4th Panzer Division on 21 September 1939 by three roads through Sochaczew into the area Szymanów-Sucha-Lasieczniki-Smolarnia-Sokule: the 5th Panzer Brigade to Bolimów, the rifle regiment around Aleksandrów and Bielice, the rear services around Wiskitki and Miedniewice, and the division staff to Szymanów. The time there is for reorganisation, replacements and cleaning, with changes to the order of battle to be reported by 23 September. It adds that Guzów is occupied by the Tenth Army headquarters, and that an area around Oryszew and Drzewicz is foreseen later for the Leibstandarte; that later area is a plan without a date and is not entered. Confidence is 0.5 because the move is only ordered. The pin is the division staff village Szymanów at 3 km.
